name: 骤影:绯月杀
detailed_description:
《Celestial Fall》 is an asymmetric competitive game that blends identity deduction with fast-paced combat, set in a fantasy Werewolf-inspired world. The Secret Flame Order is tasked with venturing into darkness-corrupted lands to halt the spread of corruption. These tainted territories hide ferocious monsters and lethal traps, but the deadliest threats lurk within the Order itself—several disguised infiltrators, Dark Priests serving the shadows, plot betrayal. When the Blood Moon rises, guardians and traitors engage in a deadly game of strategy. Will they stand their ground in desperation, or flee into a carefully laid trap? Truth and destiny await revelation through sword and sorcery.


​​Contested Corruption Zones​​

• As a member of the Secret Flame Order, you are tasked with venturing into the darkness-corrupted lands to halt the spread of corruption.

• Dark Priests hidden within the Order will stop at nothing to secretly spread corruption or eliminate fellow members.

• Each night, members may initiate a trial to expose infiltrators, but some will spread lies to obscure the truth during the proceedings.

​​Blood Moon Evacuation​​

• When corruption engulfs the land, the Blood Moon rises, forcing the Order to escort the Lord and key figures to safety.

• The Secret Flame Order must resist waves of zombies and foes, safeguarding the caravan until it reaches the evacuation point.

◦ ​​Order Victory​​: Success if the caravan arrives intact.

• Dark Priests will sabotage the evacuation with traps, deception, and ambushes to halt progress.

◦ ​​Dark Victory​​: Achieved if the Lord is eliminated before reaching the evacuation point.

• Loyalty may crumble in moments; trust itself becomes the deadliest weapon.

• Both factions wield multiple strategic paths to triumph.


​​Corrupted Lands​​

• Across these tainted lands, players must search for and neutralize ​​corruption sources​​ to cleanse the region.

◦ Corruption sources lurk in unexpected places—a village well, a clandestine gathering, or even sacred grounds.

• While investigating, players face relentless threats:

◦ Rotting zombies, ruthless bandits, fanatical cultists, and powerful wraiths spawned by the corruption itself.

• Gather resources by scavenging materials, defeating enemies, and solving puzzles to craft potent weapons and master devastating spells.



​​Sword and Sorcery​​

• Members of the Secret Flame Order hail from diverse cultures, wielding unique ​​combat arts​​ or ​​spells​​.

◦ ​​Combat Arts​​: Innate abilities unique to each character.

◦ ​​Spells​​: Mostly discovered by exploring the map or deciphering ancient texts.

• Dark Priests possess additional abilities to sabotage covertly, twisting the land's magic to their will.

Will you light the Sacred Flame... or extinguish it forever?

short_description: Celestial Fall is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?
